meta.title: PFAS amendments — experiment
meta.description: Explore, compare and cite amendments to the PFAS bill from a dated public Senate snapshot.

header.title: PFAS bill: explore and compare amendments
header.intro: Find the amendments to an article, compare their actual proposal texts, check the recorded outcome and open the official source. Official excerpts are shown in French, as published.

explorer.summary: {groups, plural, one {# placement} other {# placements}} · {count, plural, one {# amendment} other {# amendments}}
explorer.help: Use the checkbox to select an amendment for comparison and the amendment button to view its details. Sub-amendments appear under their parent only when the link is sourced.

amendment.author: Author
amendment.noSource: No valid Senate link in the export
amendment.placeholder: Choose an amendment in the structure to see its outcome, source and text.

comparison.title: Lexical comparison
comparison.empty: Select two amendments to compare their proposal texts side by side.
comparison.one: Select one more amendment to compare.
comparison.disclaimer: Word-level differences between the two proposal texts. A lexical difference is not a claim about legal effect, scope or equivalence.
comparison.legendShared: Plain text: words found in both proposals, in the same order.
comparison.legendUnique: words found only in this proposal (announced to screen readers).
comparison.uniqueCount: {count, plural, =0 {No word unique to this proposal} one {# token unique to this proposal} other {# tokens unique to this proposal}}
comparison.tooLong: Texts too long for an in-browser comparison; full texts are shown without highlighting.
comparison.explanatoryHint: Shown separately: they state the authors' intent and are not compared.

export.local: Note generated in your browser, without sending its contents.

note.title: PFAS amendments {numbers}: sourced comparison
note.snapshotWarning: Dated public Senate snapshot, not current law and not a live import. Note generated
note.limitation1: This comparison is lexical only. It does not simulate legal or environmental outcomes and does not assess legal equivalence or scope.
note.limitation2: Outcomes are copied as recorded in the Senate export; no vote is inferred when none is recorded.
note.limitation3: The corpus is a dated snapshot of a 2023-2024 Senate stage. Check the official pages for later stages.
note.limitation4: Official texts are quoted in French without translation.

evidence.title: Three questions to check
evidence.scope: Answers built from the dated Senate snapshot (2024) and a verified documentary context. They state neither the legal effect of a proposal nor the current law.

wording.question: What differs between these two amendments?
wording.result: Amendments no. 26 and 27 are selected and compared below. Recorded outcomes:
wording.caution: These are two distinct proposals filed on the same article, not successive versions. A wording difference says nothing about legal effect.

parent.question: Which amendment is no. 32 attached to?
parent.result: No. {child} is a sub-amendment of amendment no. {parent}. This link is recorded in the official snapshot; it is not inferred.
parent.action: Go to the detail of no. {child}

trail.question: Where do these amendments fit in the legislative dossier?
trail.title: Document trail
trail.error: The documentary context is unavailable or invalid. The graph, list and comparison remain usable.
trail.empty: No verified document is available for this trail.
trail.caution: These documents place the proposals in the file. They establish no causal link between an amendment and the law, and do not describe current consolidated law.

unavailable.missing: Question unavailable: amendment no. {numbers} is missing from the snapshot.
unavailable.ambiguous: Question unavailable: several records share no. {numbers}.
unavailable.parent-mismatch: Question unavailable: the recorded parent relation does not match the expected reference ({numbers}). No link is guessed.
